title: Five stages, not a switch
sub: Film 1 of 7 of From helper to colleague: how an agent earns its freedom, one kind of task at a time. In 1987 New Zealand made its driving licence come in three stages, each with its own limits. Anil's workload agent is at four stages at once, one for each kind of task, each reached through its gate; after one night in October, one task went down a stage, and earned its way back.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's marble and oak. Its colours mean the same in every film: blue is tools and structure (the stages, their gates and the limits), violet the model thinking, orange data coming back, green a check that passes or a gate passed, and amber a check that fails, a loop, or a task moved down a stage.
